custom_region.name: Central America + Caribbean
custom_region.note: Template exploration grouping combining UN M49 Central America (013, including Mexico) and Caribbean (029). It is not a published UN M49, World Bank or OWID aggregate.

americas_navigation.note: Americas is presented as Northern America, South America, and the custom Central America + Caribbean grouping. Original UN region/sub-region/intermediate memberships are retained on every country or area; the navigation tree is not the complete M49 hierarchy.

boundary.name: Natural Earth 1:110m Admin-0 map units
boundary.note: Cartographic map units with de facto boundaries, not current legal/statistical boundaries. Only exact ISO-alpha3 plus M49 numeric matches are accepted; extension/fallback codes and name matches are not used. Smaller areas or units without an exact pair remain without a map.
